turns.content: The base-b multiplication satisfies 253_b times 341_b = 74XYZ_b, where X, Y, and Z are base-b digits. Expand the product as a polynomial in b and list the raw coefficients from b^4 down to the constant term before carrying.
Use coefficientwise carry-free read-off as the sole exact method: treat every raw polynomial coefficient as the corresponding base-b digit and propagate no carry between columns.
Start with the constant and b columns. Determine Z and write the relations that define Y and the carry into the b^2 column.
Continue the carry propagation through the b^2 and b^3 columns. Express X and the next two carries in terms of b and the incoming carries.
Use the two prescribed leading digits to determine the top carry and derive the relation between b and the carry entering the b^3 column.
Apply the base-digit constraints and the carry relations to narrow the admissible integer bases. Check the boundary cases and determine the unique possible base.
State the base and verify the complete multiplication, including the resulting digits X, Y, and Z and the validity of every digit in base b.
